mapper.sql: id, tenant_id as tenantId, project_id as projectId, owner_id as ownerId, title, goal, scope, status, version, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.investigation_task (id, tenant_id, project_id, owner_id, title, goal, scope, status, version) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{goal}, cast(#{scope} as jsonb), #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: select from pep_agent.investigation_task where id = #{id} for update
select coalesce(max(seq), 0) from pep_agent.task_event where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.task_event (id, task_id, seq, type, payload, actor_id) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{seq}, #{type}, cast(#{payload} as jsonb), #{actorId})
mapper.select: select id, tenant_id as tenantId, project_id as projectId, source_type as sourceType, source_id as sourceId, source_version as sourceVersion, content_hash as contentHash, summary, raw_ref as rawRef, scope, collected_at as collectedAt, expires_at as expiresAt, metadata, created_at as createdAt from pep_agent.evidence_item where project_id = #{projectId} and source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and content_hash = #{contentHash} order by created_at limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.evidence_item (id, tenant_id, project_id, source_type, source_id, source_version, content_hash, summary, raw_ref, scope, collected_at, expires_at, metadata) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceVersion}, #{contentHash}, #{summary}, #{rawRef}, cast(#{scope} as jsonb), #{collectedAt}, #{expiresAt}, cast(#{metadata} as jsonb))
insert into pep_agent.task_evidence (task_id, evidence_id, added_by) values (#{taskId}, #{evidenceId}, #{addedBy}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select e.id, e.tenant_id as tenantId, e.project_id as projectId, e.source_type as sourceType, e.source_id as sourceId, e.source_version as sourceVersion, e.content_hash as contentHash, e.summary, e.raw_ref as rawRef, e.scope, e.collected_at as collectedAt, e.expires_at as expiresAt, e.metadata, e.created_at as createdAt from pep_agent.task_evidence te join pep_agent.evidence_item e on e.id = te.evidence_id where te.task_id = #{taskId} order by te.created_at, e.id
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.diagnostic_hypothesis (id, task_id, statement, status, support_refs, created_by) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{statement}, #{status}, cast(#{supportRefs} as jsonb), #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select id, task_id as taskId, statement, status, support_refs as supportRefs, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from pep_agent.diagnostic_hypothesis where task_id = #{taskId} order by created_at, id
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.task_experiment (id, task_id, scenario_release_id, sim_run_id, status, result_summary, result_ref, expected_assertion, created_by) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{scenarioReleaseId}, #{simRunId}, #{status}, #{resultSummary}, #{resultRef}, cast(#{expectedAssertion} as jsonb), #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select id, task_id as taskId, scenario_release_id as scenarioReleaseId, sim_run_id as simRunId, status, result_summary as resultSummary, result_ref as resultRef, expected_assertion as expectedAssertion, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from pep_agent.task_experiment where task_id = #{taskId} order by created_at, id
mapper.update: update pep_agent.task_experiment set status = #{status}, sim_run_id = coalesce(#{simRunId}, sim_run_id), result_summary = coalesce(#{resultSummary}, result_summary), result_ref = coalesce(#{resultRef}, result_ref), updated_at = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 from pep_agent.task_conclusion where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.task_conclusion (id, task_id, version, conclusion, evidence_refs, validation_status, created_by) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{version}, #{conclusion}, cast(#{evidenceRefs} as jsonb), #{validationStatus}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select id, task_id as taskId, version, conclusion, evidence_refs as evidenceRefs, validation_status as validationStatus, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt from pep_agent.task_conclusion where task_id = #{taskId} order by version desc
mapper.insert: insert into pep_agent.action_approval (id, task_id, action_type, target, param_hash, approved_by, expires_at, state) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{actionType}, cast(#{target} as jsonb), #{paramHash}, #{approvedBy}, #{expiresAt}, #{state})
mapper.select: select id, task_id as taskId, action_type as actionType, target, param_hash as paramHash, approved_by as approvedBy, expires_at as expiresAt, used_at as usedAt, state, created_at as createdAt from pep_agent.action_approval where task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{id}
mapper.update: update pep_agent.action_approval set state = 'USED', used_at = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{id} and state = 'PENDING' and expires_at > now()
mapper.select: select id, task_id as taskId, action_type as actionType, target, param_hash as paramHash, approved_by as approvedBy, expires_at as expiresAt, used_at as usedAt, state, created_at as createdAt from pep_agent.action_approval where task_id = #{taskId} order by created_at desc, id desc
